name: fractal-office
description: Local AI office suite powered by the authenticated Codex CLI

scripts.test: npm run test -w @fractal-office/i18n && npm run test -w @fractal-office/electron-utils && npm run test -w @fractal-office/docx-engine && npm run test -w @fractal-office/file-parse && npm run test -w @fractal-office/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @fractal-office/pptx-render && npm run test -w @fractal-office/ai-search && npm run test -w @fractal-office/agent-core && npm run test -w @fractal-office/ai-provider && npm run test -w @fractal-office/project-store && npm run test -w @fractal-office/docs && npm run test -w @fractal-office/sheets && npm run test -w @fractal-office/shell && npm run test -w @fractal-office/slides && npm run test -w @fractal-office/pdf
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/ui && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/docs && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/shell && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/slides && npm run typecheck -w @fractal-office/pdf
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @fractal-office/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @fractal-office/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @fractal-office/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @fractal-office/pdf" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 npm run dev -w @fractal-office/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @fractal-office/docs && npm run build -w @fractal-office/sheets && npm run build -w @fractal-office/slides && npm run build -w @fractal-office/pdf && npm run build -w @fractal-office/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:mac -w @fractal-office/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @fractal-office/shell
